question: Select the synonym of **Recalcitrant.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disobedient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Recalcitrant"** refers to someone or something that is resistant to authority or control; stubbornly disobedient or uncooperative. (अवज्ञाकारी या हठी)

 
 
• **Example:** The recalcitrant child refused to follow the teacher's instructions, causing disruptions in the classroom.
 
 
 
• **"Disobedient"** means not following rules or instructions, showing a lack of willingness to comply with authority. (अवज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** The disobedient employee ignored the manager's orders and completed the task incorrectly.
 
 
 
• Thus, "Disobedient" is a synonym for "Recalcitrant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disobedient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Loyal** (वफादार): Showing firm and constant support or allegiance to someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The dog was loyal to its owner and never left his side.
 
 
 
• **Submissive** (आज्ञाकारी): Ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient or passive.
 
 
• **Example:** She was submissive to her parents' rules and never questioned their decisions.
 
 
 
• **Supportive** (सहायक): Providing encouragement or emotional help.
 
 
• **Example:** His supportive friends helped him through the difficult times.
